summary: --- name: Clawdbot description: Use when setting up, configuring, or operating OpenClaw — a self-hosted multi-channel AI agent gateway. Reach for this skill when building agent workspaces, managing channels (WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, etc.), configuring models and tools, setting up multi-agent routing, creating skills, or troubleshooting gateway operations. metadata: mintlify-proj: clawdbot version: "1.0" --- # OpenClaw Skill Reference ## Product summary OpenClaw is a self-hosted gateway that connects messaging apps (WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, iMessage, Signal, and more) to AI agents. A single Gateway process runs on your machine or server and routes inbound messages to agents, manages sessions, handles tool execution, and streams responses back to channels. Key files: `~/.openclaw/openclaw.json` (config), `~/.openclaw/workspace/` (agent workspace with AGENTS.md, SOUL.md, TOOLS.md), `~/.openclaw/agents/<agentId>/sessions/` (session transcripts). Primary CLI: `openclaw` with subcommands for setup, configuration, channels, agents, models, and gateway control. See https://docs.openclaw.ai for comprehensive documentation.
